mode: Native PostgreSQL reads of fully declared external tables, views and materialized views with UTF-8, standard-conforming strings and pg_catalog first.

ExternalRelationKind.role: Closed classification of the external relation resolved by an input occurrence.
ExternalRelationKind.structure: A base table, a view or a materialized view.
ExternalRelationKind.conditions: The declaring catalog and evaluator agree on the kind and heading at the absolute identity.
ExternalRelationKind.meaning: Read the external table, live view or materialized relation and use the external engine's inheritance semantics.
ExternalRelationKind.sql: The FROM position and absolute identity name the external relation regardless of kind. ONLY is a separate explicit policy.

structure: A table source owns the absolute schema and name, external relation kind, ONLY policy and an ordered consumed field layout with exact native kinds. Each projected or predicate field addresses the owning occurrence.
conditions: Analysis resolves a complete input declaration with an admitted relation kind. Each field belongs to the selected occurrence and uses its native role. INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE still require an admitted base-table destination. View assignment, foreign and sequence sources have separate unchecked capabilities in the work scope.
meaning: Use the external environment's declared relation at the fixed identity. A live view and a persisted snapshot can disagree after a base write, and ONLY changes descendant inclusion for a base table. An aliased or qualified repeat of a resolved field uses the same slot. Preserve outer-join null extension, field order, duplicates and native types.
sql: Emit the fully qualified source with the controlled alias and the explicit ONLY policy. Render each field with the owning occurrence alias and its checked name. External relation definitions are fixture or evaluation inputs.

finite.completeness: Observe all 96 distinct combinations by recovering the relation kind, source occurrence, inheritance policy, typed field layout, filter and result-order policy from the constructed graph. Generate the allowed Cartesian product without filtering.

evidence.P01: Retain a closed relation kind and exact native field roles with absolute identity and occurrence.
evidence.P02: Enforce source and destination placement at the responsible analysis or public boundary.
evidence.P03: Keep external identification and consumed field roles as semantic values without the declaration or query definition.
evidence.P04: Compose rows from the fixed external input with checked projection, filter, outer joins and sort positions.
evidence.P05: Use immutable closed kind and identifier slots and detached field lists.
evidence.P06: Render typed source reads preserving native labels, values, order, multiplicity, NULL and inheritance.
evidence.Q01: Check positive source construction and typed destination and resolution rejection.
evidence.Q02: Run every finite identity on both profiles as well as the independent analyzed inputs.
evidence.Q03: Compare the composition of row environments by occurrence and backing relation.
evidence.Q04: Compare native output to independent typed row predictions, including live and stale snapshots and inherited rows.
evidence.Q05: Link distributor bytes to the checked constructor, binder, renderer and write boundary.
